Important announcement for travelers
It is easier with this note

Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

Travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways need to review their animal travel papers and comfort plans before departure. Please keep your carrier, feeding items, and contact details ready so our team can support a calm handoff and a steady journey.

The senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions, and the welfare coordinator reviews animal comfort needs for each case. We treat every journey as a shared responsibility, with care for both traveler and pet from check-in to arrival. <<FACT F120>> Any report of harm or concern should be made at once, and the team will guide the next steps with care. <<FACT F113>> Please share complete travel details and any special handling notes so our staff can prepare properly and help avoid delay.

If you are traveling with a pet, please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for assistance before you proceed.
